summary: KB Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Kookmin Bank, declared an interim cash dividend of KRW 3,460 per common share, totaling KRW 1,399,151,741,360. The record date is July 2, 2026, with payment expected on July 22, 2026, subject to change. The entire dividend will be paid to KB Financial Group Inc., as the sole shareholder of Kookmin Bank. The dividend is authorized under Article 53 of Kookmin Bank's Articles of Incorporation and Korean commercial law. This capital return to the parent company may precede a distribution to KB Financial Group's own shareholders or be used for corporate purposes. No premium or strategic change is involved; the filing is a routine dividend declaration, but it constitutes a capital return event at the subsidiary level. What to watch: the potential for further upstreaming of dividends to KB Financial Group's public shareholders and any impact on the group's capital ratios.
